```{r, echo = F, warning = F}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(msa))
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")

top_groups <- function(results, column_id){
  return(table(results[[column_id]])[order(table(results[[column_id]]), decreasing = T)])
}
```


```{r, echo = F, warning = F}
tmp <- read.csv("~/Downloads/S19-NTGAV-Family-MMseqs2-H80-aligned-recluster14Mar24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```


## Initial Logo Plot (All `NTGAV`-Consensus Clones in Database: `S19`)

```{r, echo = F, warning = F}
tmp$member_junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(tmp$member_junction_aa)
# Pull most frequent CDR3
common_CDR3 <- names(table(tmp$member_junction_aa)[order(table(tmp$member_junction_aa), decreasing = T)][1])

tmp_frame <- tmp

if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
    #cat("Group ID: ", unique(tmp_frame$centroid_sequence_id), '\n', sep = '')
    cat("Overall Members: ", nrow(tmp_frame), '\n', sep = '')
    cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$Aligned_Members)), '\n', sep = '')
    cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$member_junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
    cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", common_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$member_junction_aa == common_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
    
    print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$member_junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
      theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", common_CDR3, sep = '')))
}
```

## Centroid Alignments for Most Frequent Families (in descending order)

```{r, echo = F, warning = F, message = F, }
#print(table(tmp$centroid_sequence_id, tmp$centroid_junction_aa))
tab <- as.data.frame(table(tmp$centroid_VHH))
colnames(tab) <- c("Centroid_VHH", "Freq")
tab <- tab[order(tab$Freq, decreasing = T),]

sequences <- Biostrings::AAStringSet(tab$Centroid_VHH)
# Perform multiple sequence alignment
msa_result <- msa::msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega", verbose = F, order = "input")
# Store aligned results
tab$Aligned_Centroids <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
print(tab[,c("Aligned_Centroids")])

#print(table(tmp$centroid_VHH))
```


## Top Clonal Family (2+ Members) Logo Plots (Per MMseqs2)

```{r, echo = F, warning=F}
tab <- top_groups(tmp, "centroid_sequence_id")

for (nm in head(names(tab), 50)){
  tmp_frame <- tmp[tmp$centroid_sequence_id == nm,]
  # Trim CDR3
  #tmp_frame$member_junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(tmp_frame$member_junction_aa)
  # Pull most frequent CDR3
  common_CDR3 <- names(table(tmp_frame$member_junction_aa)[order(table(tmp_frame$member_junction_aa), decreasing = T)][1])
  
  if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
      cat("Group ID: ", unique(tmp_frame$centroid_sequence_id), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Centroid Sequence:\n", unique(tmp_frame$centroid_VHH), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Overall Members: ", nrow(tmp_frame), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$Aligned_Members)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$member_junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", common_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$member_junction_aa == common_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
      print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$member_junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
        theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", common_CDR3, sep = '')))
  }
}

```
